comment: GitHub #132, since 0.2.0-dev.31.12: block placements count and pay from a player's crafting sources linked with CraftSourceOptions.Building. (1) The build cursor's material check (S 0x99750, C 0x28ab60; rules/CursorFlags' bit 12 MissingMaterials, docs/re/rules.md 2.1), in every world: for an item with a voxel object (a blueprint shape) it counts the material in the player's inventories (InventoryItemCount, the count at [rsp+0x58] -> ebx), then the base's crafting stock at the cursor (build/StockCount: S 0x209210, C 0x4709c0; a client world reads its published stock map at bases+0x1610, a server world the base's stock list) -> eax, and sets the bit when eax + ebx < ebp (the blocks needed). build/CursorStockRet is that call's return; kiln-items' mid hook there reads eax, ebx, ebp, rsi (the cursor query: the material item at [[rsi+0x68]]) and rdi (the cursor context: its first qword is the program context), which the literal bytes pin; the cursor context's other offsets differ between the two executables and are wildcards. (2) The placement's payment: player_building_blueprints (S 0xc4410) calls rules/ApplyMaterials(ctx {u8 mode 0; tx}, list, take) at build/BlueprintApplyRet - 5, which calls rules/InventoryPay(tx, list, [tx+0xe0] the operator, 1, 0) returning to build/ApplyMaterialsPaid. kiln-items scopes a RawHook on ApplyMaterials to that one caller; the payment is kiln.stations' craft adapter with the player's building links. Props, undo, dismantle, impact natives and terraforming loot stay the game's. Server 26430253 (f0d824be) and client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1). Evidence: docs/re/stations.md section 13.

build/CursorStockRet.comment: the blueprint branch of the cursor's material check: lea r9,[rsp+0x40]; mov r8,[rsi+0x68]; ... mov r8d,[r8] (the material); mov ebx,[rsp+0x58] (the bag's count); ... call build/StockCount; add eax,ebx; cmp eax,ebp; jae (enough). The return address. Server 0x99a50, client 0x28ae3c

build/BlueprintApplyRet.comment: player_building_blueprints' payment: movzx r8d,r12b (take); lea rcx,[rsp+0x50] (the cost context: mode 0, the transaction); mov rdx,rdi (the list); call rules/ApplyMaterials; test al,al; je (refused). The return address. Server 0xc4b50, client 0x2d8bb0

build/ApplyMaterialsPaid.comment: ApplyMaterials' take in mode 0: mov r8d,[rcx+0xe0] (the transaction's operator); mov [rsp+0x20],rbx (no item override); call rules/InventoryPay; mov rbx,[rsp+0x98]; test eax,eax; sete al. The return address. Server 0x22d562, client 0x496002 (the call's target is checked against rules/InventoryPay by kiln-items, call_matches)
